															Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																
																Pay Scale: JMGS-I (23700-980/7-30560-1145/2-32850-1310/7-42020).
																
																
																Mode of Selection: Selection on the Basis of Online Test, Screening and Interview.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															SBI CBO Recruitment 2026: Selection Procedure 

															The selection process consists of Online Test, Screening, and Interview.
															
															(a) Online Test: Online Test will consist of Objective Tests for 120 marks and Descriptive Test for 50 marks. The Descriptive Test will be administered immediately after conclusion of the Objective Test and candidates will have to type their Descriptive Test answers on the computer.
															
															(i) Objective Test:
															Duration: 2 hours | Total Marks: 120
															The test consists of the following four sections:

															
																
																	
																		Test

															(ii) Descriptive Test:
															Duration: 30 minutes | Total Marks: 50
															It will include Letter Writing and Essay. Minimum qualifying marks must be scored as decided by the Bank.
															
															Penalty for Wrong Answers: No penalty for wrong answers in the Objective Test.
															Sectional Marks: Sectional marks will not be maintained for the Online Exam.
															
															(b) Screening:
															Applications of candidates who qualified the Online Exam will be screened for experience by the Committee. If experience does not match the required job profile, the application will be rejected. No correspondence in this matter will be entertained. Shortlisted candidates (up to 3 times the number of vacancies) will be called for interview.
															
															(c) Interview:
															Total Marks: 50. Minimum qualifying marks will be set by the Bank. Candidates must qualify to be considered for final selection.
															
															(d) Final Selection:
															Based on qualifying in both Online Test and Interview. Final merit list will be prepared based on:
															- Online Test (scaled to 75 marks)
															- Interview (scaled to 25 marks)
															Total = 100 marks
															
															(e) Local Language Proficiency Test:
															Candidates should be proficient in the local language of the applied Circle. Those who fail the test will not be appointed. Exemption is allowed for candidates with proof of local language study in class 10 or 12.
															
															Result Publication:
															Results will be available on the Bank’s website.
															
														
														
															
															SBI CBO Recruitment 2026: List of documents to be uploaded

															The list of the documents to be uploaded is as below:
															
															i. Recent Photograph (jpg/jpeg)
															ii. Signature (jpg/jpeg)
															iii. Left Thumb Impression (jpg/jpeg)
															iv. Hand written declaration (jpg/jpeg)
															v. ID Proof (PDF)
															vi. Proof of Date of Birth (PDF)
															vii. Job Profile (certified by existing/previous employers) (PDF)
															viii. Brief Resume – detailing educational/professional qualification, experience and assignments handled (PDF)
															ix. Educational Certificates – Relevant Mark-Sheets/ Degree/ Certificate (PDF)
															x. Experience Certificate/ Appointment Letter / Job Offer Letter (PDF)
															xi. Latest Form-16 issued by employer (PDF)
															xii. Latest Salary Slip (PDF)

															Duration: 30 minutes | Total Marks: 50
															It will include Letter Writing and Essay. Minimum qualifying marks must be scored as decided by the Bank.
															
															Penalty for Wrong Answers: No penalty for wrong answers in the Objective Test.
															Sectional Marks: Sectional marks will not be maintained for the Online Exam.
															
															(b) Screening:
															Applications of candidates who qualified the Online Exam will be screened for experience by the Committee. 															(c) Interview:
															Total Marks: 50. Minimum qualifying marks will be set by the Bank. Candidates must qualify to be considered for final selection.

															Based on qualifying in both Online Test and Interview. Final merit list will be prepared based on:
															- Online Test (scaled to 75 marks)
															- Interview (scaled to 25 marks)
															Total = 100 marks

															Candidates should be proficient in the local language of the applied Circle. Those who fail the test will not be appointed. Exemption is allowed for candidates with proof of local language study in class 10 or 12.

															Results will be available on the Bank’s website.

															SBI CBO Recruitment 2026: Selection Procedure 

															The selection process consists of Online Test, Screening, and Interview.
															
															(a) Online Test: Online Test will consist of Objective Tests for 120 marks and Descriptive Test for 50 marks. The Descriptive Test will be administered immediately after conclusion of the Objective Test and candidates will have to type their Descriptive Test answers on the computer.
															
															(i) Objective Test:
															Duration: 2 hours | Total Marks: 120

															(ii) Descriptive Test:
															Duration: 30 minutes | Total Marks: 50
															It will include Letter Writing and Essay. Minimum qualifying marks must be scored as decided by the Bank.
															
															Penalty for Wrong Answers: No penalty for wrong answers in the Objective Test.
															Sectional Marks: Sectional marks will not be maintained for the Online Exam.
															
															(b) Screening:
															Applications of candidates who qualified the Online Exam will be screened for experience by the Committee. If experience does not match the required job profile, the application will be rejected. No correspondence in this matter will be entertained. Shortlisted candidates (up to 3 times the number of vacancies) will be called for interview.
															
															(c) Interview:
															Total Marks: 50. Minimum qualifying marks will be set by the Bank. Candidates must qualify to be considered for final selection.
															
															(d) Final Selection:
															Based on qualifying in both Online Test and Interview. Final merit list will be prepared based on:
															- Online Test (scaled to 75 marks)
															- Interview (scaled to 25 marks)
															Total = 100 marks
															
															(e) Local Language Proficiency Test:
															Candidates should be proficient in the local language of the applied Circle. Those who fail the test will not be appointed. Exemption is allowed for candidates with proof of local language study in class 10 or 12.
															
															Result Publication:
															Results will be available on the Bank’s website.
